summary: Verified new Analytics extensions (Brend baxışları + Kateqoriya trendi). As anonymous visitor, seeded tracking by visiting /products?brand=Zippo, Despada, Cavalli and /products?category=Eynek, Cüzdan, Saat (each ~3.5s apart, distinct so throttle doesn't block). Then set localStorage userRole=admin, opened /admin → Analitika sidebar, entered section password '2345', stayed on overview sub-tab, clicked 'Yenilə'. All required data-testids present and populated: brand-views-card ('Cəmi 3 baxış · 3 brend'), brand-most-viewed=Cavalli/1 dəfə baxılıb, brand-least-viewed=Zippo/1 dəfə baxılıb, brand-view-0/1/2 for Cavalli/Despada/Zippo each '1 dəfə'. category-trend-card with category-trend-0..2 (Cüzdan/Eynek/Saat) each showing '7 gün 1', badge '↑ yeni' (expected since no prev-7 data), '30 gün 1'. Screenshots captured. Category-view TRACKING correctly writes both aggregate and daily bucket (older 'Saat/EYNƏK/ÜZÜK' rows in Kateqoriya baxışları confirm existing tracker still works; new daily bucket for today confirms trend writer works too).

issues: Cards render cleanly; badge '↑ yeni' shown as expected because prev-7-day window is empty for brand-new tracking. No visual issues.

critical_code_review_comments: Repeated React DOM warning in console: '<a> cannot appear as a descendant of <a>' on ProductsPage — nested <Link>/<a>. Not blocking but should be fixed (unrelated to this task).
ProductService.getAll runs many times on each products page mount (8+ duplicate fetches per navigation). Consider memoizing or a single fetch — perf smell (pre-existing).
test_credentials: Analitika section password: 2345 (worked). Admin gate via localStorage userRole=admin.
seed_data_creation: Firestore brand_view_counts: Cavalli/Despada/Zippo (1 each). category_view_daily today bucket: Cüzdan/Eynek/Saat (1 each).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand+category trend tracking + admin cards fully working. Note 60s throttle per brand/category — for further tests use different names or wait. Password for Analitika section is '2345'. Older category tracker (Saat=3, EYNƏK=2, ÜZÜK=2) coexists with new lowercase entries from this run (Cüzdan/Eynek/Saat=1) — trackCategoryView normalizes but slug id is separate from displayed label case, hence duplicate rows may appear. Consider case-insensitive merging in aggregation if that matters.
